sources.intro: Flexibx reads insights from the Facebook Pages and Instagram professional accounts your Meta connection manages. metaDataDeletion.title: Facebook data deletion
metaDataDeletion.completed: Your data deletion request is complete. Confirmation code: {code}.

removed.title: What Flexibx deletes
removed.body: When you remove Flexibx from your Facebook settings, or ask Facebook to delete your data, Flexibx immediately disconnects every Meta ads and WhatsApp connection linked to your Facebook account, in every workspace, and erases their access tokens. For a deletion request it also erases the Facebook user id and name it stored for you. Nothing further is read from or sent to Meta with your permission. A connection you granted again after the request is a new consent and is kept.

kept.title: What the workspace keeps
kept.body: Ad plans, approvals, audit records and synced campaign results belong to the business workspace that connected its ad accounts, not to your personal Facebook profile, and stay with that workspace.

yourself.title: Do it yourself
yourself.body: In Flexibx: open the workspace's Integrations page and choose Disconnect. On Facebook: Settings & privacy → Settings → Business integrations (or Apps and websites) → remove Flexibx. Either one revokes access immediately.

contact.title: Anything else
contact.body: To have workspace data deleted, ask the workspace owner, or contact the operator of this Flexibx service.
